[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.10x 5-day average): surge in volume, increasing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): holding off on buy entries due to RSI entering oversold and MACD continuing to weaken, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
